courses.title: Introduction to Italian Literature

courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.title: Tradition and Change in Contemporary Italy
courses.description: An analysis of Italy's trends and of conflicting values in its political, economic, and social development. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.

courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian through Creative Writing
courses.description: Develop knowledge of Italian lexicon and its grammar through creative writing practice. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian through Cuisine
courses.description: Refine reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills in Italian through the context of gastronomy. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.title: Composition and Conversation

courses.title: Advanced Composition and Conversation

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Topics in Italian Studies
courses.description: Analysis of Italian culture. Texts include literature, film, popular culture, and other forms. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or Italian 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or Italian 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: The Language of Italian Crime Fiction
courses.description: Analyze Italian language and culture as reflected in the crime fiction genre studies through literature, film, popular culture, and other forms. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 330 (Topic: Lang of Ital Crime Fiction) and 330C may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian across Disciplines
courses.description: Students read and discuss Italian language materials related to the subject matter of another designated course. One lecture hour a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing, three semester hours of upper-division coursework in Italian, and consent of instructor.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing, three semester hours of upper-division coursework in Italian, and consent of instructor.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Introduction to Italian Linguistics
courses.description: Examine fundamental aspects of the Italian language including its structure as well as geographical, socio-cultural and communicative variation. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian Translation Workshop
courses.description: Focuses on the practical aspects of translation as a means to expand students' resources by practicing and improving grammar, style and lexicon. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 330K (Topic: Italian Translation Workshop) and 332 may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian Politics
courses.description: Explore the Italian language, culture, and society through the examination of Italy's political system and the organization of the Italian government. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian Popular Cinema
courses.description: Analysis of Italian genre films (melodrama, comedy, horror, western, action), in their cultural and historical contexts. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 331 (Topic: Italian Popular Cinema) and 347 may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian Drama Workshop
courses.description: Intensive analysis of one or several plays or short literary texts, with emphasis on diction, delivery of lines, and acting and staging. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian Internship
courses.description: Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C and consent of the department.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C and consent of the department.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Supervised Research
courses.description: Individual instruction. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C and consent of the department.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 or 328 with a grade of at least C and consent of the department.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Conference Course in Italian Language and Literature
courses.description: Course content varies according to needs of students; designed to fill in gaps and give students a good overall picture of the development of Italian literature. Conference course. Prerequisite: Upper-division standing and consent of the undergraduate adviser or the chair. Italian majors may take conference courses only in exceptional cases.
courses.prereqText: Upper-division standing and consent of the undergraduate adviser or the chair. Italian majors may take conference courses only in exceptional cases.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: The Antihero in the Twentieth-Century Italian Novel
courses.description: Explore the crisis of certainties at the turn of the last century and the end of the role of the hero, through the examination of major Italian novels. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 375 (Topic 2) and 375C may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Writing Fascism: Writing the Resistance
courses.description: Examine major novels dealing with the Italian narrative on World War II and the resistance. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 375 (Topic 1) and 375F may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Neorealism and its Legacy
courses.description: Analyze the legacy of neorealism in Italian literature and cinema from approximately the late 1940s to the early 1950s. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 375 (Topic 4) and 375N may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Sicily in Literature and Film
courses.description: Examine Sicilian culture through novels and films. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Italian 375 (Topic 3) and 375S may not both be counted. Prerequisite: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.
courses.prereqText: Italian 320 with a grade of at least C.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Honors Tutorial Course
courses.description: Supervised individual research on a literary, linguistic, or cultural topic, and writing and defense of a thesis under the direction of a committee of two faculty members. Conference course. Prerequisite: Admission to the Italian Honors Program.
courses.prereqText: Admission to the Italian Honors Program.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Italian for Graduate Students in Other Departments
courses.description: No auditors permitted. Intensive reading course, emphasizing basic grammar and vocabulary with translation practice. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. The symbol CR fulfills the foreign language requirement for the Doctor of Philosophy degree in some departments. Offered on the credit/no credit basis only. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.
courses.offering: Offered on the credit/no credit basis only.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: History of the Italian Language
courses.description: Survey of the development of Italian from spoken Latin to the present day. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Introduction to Studies in Literature and Culture
courses.description: Proseminar in methods of study and research in Italian Studies. One lecture hour a week for one semester. Offered on the credit/no credit basis only. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and consent of the graduate adviser.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and consent of the graduate adviser.
courses.offering: Offered on the credit/no credit basis only.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Doctoral Writing Workshop
courses.description: Restricted to students in the French and Italian Doctor of Philosophy program. Acquire the crucial skills for writing a cogent prospectus, dissertation, or article, and complete the prospectus, dissertation chapter, or article. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Offered on the credit/no credit basis only. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.
courses.restricted: Restricted to students in the French and Italian Doctor of Philosophy program.
courses.offering: Offered on the credit/no credit basis only.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Topics in Readings in Italian Literature
courses.description: Intensive study of a period or a major writer. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Italian.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and six semester hours of upper-division coursework in Italian.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Topics in Italian Studies
courses.description: Study of various aspects and periods of Italian culture and society. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit when the topics vary. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Studies in Italian Language
courses.description: Synchronic approach to the modern Italian language: phonology, morphology, syntax, lexicology, stylistics. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. Prerequisite: Graduate standing.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Conference Course in Italian Language and Literature
courses.description: For students needing specialized courses not normally or not often included in the regular course offerings. Three lecture hours a week for one semester. May be repeated for credit. Prerequisite: Graduate standing and written consent of the graduate adviser.
courses.prereqText: Graduate standing and written consent of the graduate adviser.

courses.subject: ITL
courses.title: Graduate Teaching Practicum
